method: Union of within-chat gaps between recorded activity events of at most 300 seconds. Longer gaps excluded; overlapping chats counted once. Rounded to nearest hour.
limitations: Approximate shared project activity, not human labor hours or model compute time.
Long builds or thinking gaps can be undercounted; short waits can be counted.
Only explicitly selected project chats included; earlier unrelated Home Assistant work excluded.
No claim that all historical work is recoverable.
